name.en: Viser Des Shock, Tormentor of the Sun God
name.ja: <ruby>太<rt>たい</rt></ruby><ruby>陽<rt>よう</rt></ruby><ruby>神<rt>しん</rt></ruby>の<ruby>拷<rt>ごう</rt></ruby><ruby>問<rt>もん</rt></ruby><ruby>具<rt>ぐ</rt></ruby>－バイサー・デス・ショック
name.ja_romaji: Taiyōshin no Gōmongu - Baisā Desu Shokku
name.zh-CN: 太阳神的拷问具－死亡震撼刑具

text.en: Cannot be destroyed by battle. You can only use each of the following effects of "Viser Des Shock, Tormentor of the Sun God" once per turn. If a monster(s) is sent to your opponent's GY and you control a "Sun God" card, even during the Damage Step: You can Special Summon this card from your hand, and if you do, return 1 other card on the field to the hand/Extra Deck, and if you do that, inflict 800 damage to your opponent. During the End Phase, if "The Immortal Sun God" was sent to your GY this turn: You can add this card from your GY to your hand.
text.zh-CN: 此卡名的①③效果1回合仅可各使用1次。①：有怪兽被送至对手墓地的情况下，如果自己场上存在“太阳神”卡则可以发动（伤害步骤也可以发动）。从手牌将此卡特殊召唤，将场上的1张其他卡放回手牌・额外牌组，给予对手800伤害。②：此卡不会因战斗被破坏。③：此回合有“不死之太阳神”被送至自己墓地的情况下，在结束阶段可以发动。将墓地的此卡加入手牌。
